context_notes: Autonomous run of the workflows-replay milestone. Phases 109-114 are complete and verified; 115-117 remain, then the milestone lifecycle. Phase 114 closed cleanly: 7/7 verified, SECURED, nyquist validated, npm run check green at 5564 unit + 34 integration. The recurring failure mode this milestone keeps hitting is an enumeration that is smaller than the set it names — it has now happened FIVE times (seven engine gates were nine; five composeReasons sites were six; two piWithBothLoaded definitions were four; seven closed-set sites were eight; a seven-entry gate literal was bound to nothing). Every one was found by removing something and watching what went red, never by listing. Its companion is a guard that is green because it checks nothing, which this milestone has shipped twice. Phase 115's VALIDATION.md therefore mandates a FOUR-direction negative control on the gate-name totality construct, with all four transcripts pasted into the SUMMARY — directions 3 (falsify a column value) and 4 (the construct's own liveness) are the ones that catch what actually shipped before.

planner_notes.module_boundary_decision: The gate reader lives INSIDE domain/workflow-script.ts — no new module. It consumes ParsedScript.ast and MetaElement[], both module-private; a new module would force exporting them and give the no-second-parse gate two scan targets.
planner_notes.totality_construct: WorkflowGate = (typeof GATE_ORDER)[number]; two Record<WorkflowGate, …> annotations (GATE_PREDICATES, GATE_REASONS) are the compile-time locks, so order and membership cannot be two hand-written lists.
